body.x: Network Korea (CEO Shin Dong-hwan, www.networkkorea.co.kr) showcased its ICM, an integrated remote control device for CCTVs, in the joint pavilion of the Mobile Technology Convergence Center (MTCC)at the world’s best IT technology exhibition ‘CES(Consumer Technology Show) 2016’ which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas Convention Center(LVCC).

The product combines M2M-based data device collection and control monitoring technology. It conducts integrated controls and self-diagnosis for facilities around CCTVs, and it comes with a remote control monitoring function.

The product can conduct self-diagnoses and automatically reports failures of various devices, including CCTVs, amps, emergency bells, warning lights, and fans. By using wireless communication technologies, such as Zigbee and Bluetooth, it provides device control and monitoring functions.

Showcased together, the automatic setting and blocking outlet for standby power detects and blocks standby power and power consumption of PCs and peripheral devices that are not being used. Each socket has an LED lamp to show the state of power. If the socket is re-plugged, it restarts and automatically resets standby power.

By using the PLC to Ethernet communication, it remotely controls and monitors each socket of the multi-outlet. It possesses application remote control and monitoring functions. The international standard AES security algorithm has been applied to the product.

Since its foundation in 2003, as a partner of telecommunication companies, the firm has been providing products that are combined with various new technologies, including transmission devices and lines. It is focusing on developing CCTVs, software, ITS, and devices for safety facilities of embedded systems.

DIP prepared the joint pavilion at this exhibition and supported related domestic companies’ participation in CES 2016, promoting the reinforcement project for quality capability of the smart knowledge service, which is a promotional project for regional-specialized businesses supported by the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy. It is mainly focused on the competitiveness reinforcement business of new mobile convergence in the global market.

Held annually in January and owned and produced by the Consumer Technology Association (CTA), CES 2016 is the world's largest exhibition to see the latest global trends in electronics and IT industry in one spot.

AVING News has been sending its reporters to CES for 11 years to introduce the new technologies and products. After the local coverage and research, AVING News will hold ‘CES 2016 Review Conference’ in AVING Studio, Korea on January 28th.
